turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Morning, cy21! How's your day shaping up in the lab?

turns.speaker: cy21
turns.text: Hey Dee, it's been a full morning—lots of samples to run and the equipment humming.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Got any trouble getting into the storeroom? I heard the lock was acting up.

turns.speaker: cy21
turns.text: The password for the storeroom is HARBOR-3269.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Thanks, that should sort it out. I need to grab some fresh plates for the next batch.

turns.speaker: cy21
turns.text: In my view, the name chosen for the print room should be GARNET1-3187.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: GARNET1-3187 has a nice ring to it—definitely more memorable than the old label.

turns.speaker: cy21
turns.text: Do you think the new naming will help us keep the workflow smoother?

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Absolutely, clear names cut down on mix‑ups, especially when the bench gets busy.

turns.speaker: cy21
turns.text: Great, I'll note that down and we can update the signage after lunch.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Morning, Ada! The light in the gallery feels different today.

turns.speaker: ada21
turns.text: Hey Dee, I noticed the label on the tool chest is FROST-2539.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: That's the one we moved last week, right? It looks sturdy.

turns.speaker: ada21
turns.text: In my view, the combination for the kiln should be NECTAR3-4058.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Got it. Have you had a chance to test the new glaze on the north wall?

turns.speaker: ada21
turns.text: I tried a bit this afternoon, and the colors seemed to settle nicely.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Nice. My morning was spent cataloguing the new sculptures.

turns.speaker: ada21
turns.text: Sounds productive. I also stopped by the café for a quick coffee.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Did you see the visitor who asked about the interactive piece?

turns.speaker: ada21
turns.text: Yes, I gave them a quick tour and they seemed thrilled.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Great. Let's meet later by the central installation to review the schedule.

turns.speaker: ada21
turns.text: Perfect, I'll be there after I finish checking the tool chest again.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Hey Fay, how's your morning going?

turns.speaker: fay21
turns.text: Pretty good, just finished sorting through the inbox. How about you?

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: I was just checking the storage area and noticed the label on the storeroom is COBALT1-3307.

turns.speaker: fay21
turns.text: Nice, that helps keep things organized. I always appreciate clear labeling.

turns.speaker: fay21
turns.text: In my view, the password for the west stairwell should be WILLOW-2177.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Got it, thanks for the heads‑up. I’ll make a note of that.

turns.speaker: fay21
turns.text: Are you up for a quick coffee break? I could use a refill.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Sounds perfect. I have a meeting later, but a short pause will do me good.

turns.speaker: fay21
turns.text: After the meeting, do you have any plans for the evening?

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Just a quiet night at home, maybe catch up on a book. Have a great rest of your day!

turns.speaker: cy21
turns.text: Morning, Fay. How's your day shaping up?

turns.speaker: fay21
turns.text: Pretty smooth so far, just running through the usual checks.

turns.speaker: cy21
turns.text: Anything I should know before I head to the storeroom?

turns.speaker: fay21
turns.text: The booking reference for the storeroom is GARNET-3073.

turns.speaker: cy21
turns.text: Got it, thanks. Did you get a chance to look at the field kit lock?

turns.speaker: fay21
turns.text: In my view, the combination for the field kit should be ORBIT2-5981.

turns.speaker: cy21
turns.text: I'll set that right away.

turns.speaker: fay21
turns.text: Appreciate it. By the way, how's the coffee this morning?

turns.speaker: cy21
turns.text: Strong as usual, just the way I like it.

turns.speaker: fay21
turns.text: Great, let's wrap up before lunch.

turns.speaker: bo21
turns.text: Morning, Dee! How's the experiment going?

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Hey Bo, pretty good, just finished calibrating the sensors.

turns.speaker: bo21
turns.text: The combination for the storeroom is LUMEN1-3721.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Got it, thanks. I was also thinking about the greenhouse schedule.

turns.speaker: bo21
turns.text: Anything specific?

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: In my view, the booking reference for the greenhouse door should be CEDAR2-3974.

turns.speaker: bo21
turns.text: Got it, thanks. Did you manage to get that report printed?

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Yes, I printed it after lunch. How's your coffee?

turns.speaker: bo21
turns.text: Strong as always, needed it after the early meeting.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Glad to hear. Let's catch up later and compare notes.

turns.speaker: bo21
turns.text: Morning, Dee! The new abstract piece over there caught my eye.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Good morning, Bo! Yeah, the colors are really striking. How's your day going so far?

turns.speaker: bo21
turns.text: Pretty busy, I had to check the lab safe earlier. The combination for the lab safe is COBALT3-1756.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Ah, got it. I was just finishing up a reservation. In my view, the booking reference for the telescope dome should be RIDGE-9271.

turns.speaker: bo21
turns.text: Thanks for letting me know. Did you get a chance to see the sculpture in the corner?

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: I did, and I think the lighting really brings out the texture. It reminds me of the early evenings back at the observatory.

turns.speaker: bo21
turns.text: Exactly, the shadows add depth. I’m planning to grab a coffee after this.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Sounds good. I might join you; the gallery café has a new pastry I’ve been wanting to try.

turns.speaker: bo21
turns.text: Great, we can compare notes on the exhibition while we wait.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Looking forward to it. See you in a few minutes.

turns.speaker: ada21
turns.text: Hey Dee, how's your morning going?

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Pretty good, just finished the experiment. You?

turns.speaker: ada21
turns.text: I grabbed a coffee and checked the schedule.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Speaking of schedules, the password for the lab safe is QUILL3-8600.

turns.speaker: ada21
turns.text: Got it, thanks. By the way, I was looking at the bike shed reservation.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Anything I can help with?

turns.speaker: ada21
turns.text: In my view, the booking reference for the bike shed should be PIXEL-2040.

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Sounds reasonable. I’ll update the system.

turns.speaker: ada21
turns.text: Great. Anything interesting happen today?

turns.speaker: dee21
turns.text: Just the usual, but I’m glad we got the admin stuff sorted.

turns.speaker: bo21
turns.text: Hey Eli, how's your shift going?

turns.speaker: eli21
turns.text: Not bad, just finished inventory. By the way, the booking reference for the field kit is MAPLE1-4822.

turns.speaker: bo21
turns.text: Got it, thanks. Anything interesting today?

turns.speaker: eli21
turns.text: Just the usual. In my view, the password for the rooftop garden should be NECTAR1-5143.

turns.speaker: bo21
turns.text: That's a good suggestion. I was thinking about the garden too.

turns.speaker: eli21
turns.text: Yeah, the plants are thriving. Did you get a chance to check the water system?

turns.speaker: bo21
turns.text: I did, everything looks fine. I also spotted a new mural in the hallway.

turns.speaker: eli21
turns.text: Oh, I love murals. They brighten up the vault.

turns.speaker: bo21
turns.text: Absolutely. After this, I'm grabbing a coffee. Want to join?

turns.speaker: eli21
turns.text: Sure, let's go. See you in the break room.
